disclaimer.heading: Before you go in
disclaimer.body: This site uses your camera to track your hand and drive interactive particles and a synth in the Lab. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere. All processing happens in your browser. If you'd rather not grant access, the site still works without a camera.
disclaimer.note: For the best experience, open this site on a computer.

hero.noCameraHint: Optional, works the same without a camera

about.body: I graduated with a degree in Sound Creation in late 2025, though the pull toward programming had always been there. That combination led me to build interactive projects in TouchDesigner and Max/MSP, crossing sound, code, and sensors to explore what happens when an idea can be touched, heard, and respond in real time.
